facts.activity_file: handing back a partially completed isolation

control_failures.control_label: controlled removal of isolation and return to service

hazard_media: stored potential of an elevated component
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: potential incident - gravity exposure at ML-3201

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ISOLATION_HANDBACK_CONTROL: the controlled removal of isolation and return to service had been bypassed, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the controlled removal of isolation and return to service on ML-3201 and M-3201 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in restoring plant to service, specifically handing back a partially completed isolation. ML-3201 (grinding mills) is in service for two-line ball milling. The task proceeded during routine operation while the controlled removal of isolation and return to service had been bypassed. The gravity energy involved is held as suspended load, and the recorded presentation was fall, collapse, crush.
response.summary: On 20 November 2021 a potential incident was recorded on ML-3201 and M-3201 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during routine operation; gravity energy held as suspended load was not released.
